summary: XMR ~$609, +4.4% in 24h and one of the strongest large caps on a red tape (Santiment's weekly had XMR +6.6%). Posts say Kraken's co-CEO publicly withdrew the XMR buyer questionnaires on Friday, easing a regulatory worry, and privacy is the only sector above its Oct 2025 peak. Much of the chatter is price-chasing, and longs are paying high funding, so kept modest. Up from -0.05.
catalyst_note: Kraken withdrew XMR buyer questionnaires 23 Oct 2026 (reported on X)
